experiences.title: Experiences
experiences.content:
- Craveu - Co-founder & CTO - Built a network of hundreds of thousands of independent agentic personas, developed an in-house high-concurrency contextual memory engine, and led SEO growth to more than one million organic users within six months.
- MyShell - App Lead - Led the mobile product from 0 to 1 for an app positioned against Character.ai, worked deeply on core in-house multimodal audio technology, and helped the team secure $8 million in early funding.
- Midjourney - Core Founding Team Member - One of the earliest AIGC developers, involved in the early build-out of a global AI super app from 0 to 1.
